ruleName: Ball Lost or Out of Bounds: Stroke-and-Distance Relief; Ball Provisional
title: Identifying the Boundary from a White Line
question: A boundary is defined by a white line on the ground. Where is the boundary?

choices.text: The outside edge of the line.
The line itself is out of bounds.
The inside edge of the line.

explanation: When a boundary is defined by a white line on the ground, the line itself (including its thickness) is out of bounds. Anything touching or beyond the line is considered out of bounds.

juniorVersion.title: Where is Out of Bounds When There Is a White Line?
juniorVersion.question: If there is a white line on the ground to show out of bounds, what counts as out of bounds?

choices.text: The edge of the line farthest from the golf course.
The whole white line is out of bounds.
The edge of the line closest to the golf course.

juniorVersion.explanation: If a white line marks out of bounds, the whole line is out of bounds. If your ball touches the line or is past it, it is out of bounds.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A place where you are not allowed to play and must play a new ball.
The line or mark that tells you where out of bounds starts.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Show some pictures or make a white line on the practice ground to help kids see what counts as out of bounds.
likelyMisconceptions: Some players may think only past the line is out of bounds, not the line itself.
Kids may think only the edge or centre of the line counts, but the whole line is out of bounds.
